_comment: The financial-guidance corpus the assistant retrieves from. Only regulators and government bodies, so the material stays neutral and citable. Text under corpus/text/ is committed and is what actually gets indexed; corpus/sources/ holds the originals and is gitignored. Regenerate the text with scripts/rag/extract.ps1 -- 'strategy' and 'fixups' record what each document needs, which differs per document and was established by measuring, not guessing.

documents.title: Financial Education Booklet
documents.notes: Lettered headings (A., B., ...). Rupee sign extracts correctly. 28% of pages are tables.

documents.title: Home Maker Module
documents.notes: Numbered headings (1., 2., ...), not lettered -- the regex must accept both.

documents.title: National Strategy for Financial Education 2020-2025
documents.notes: Policy document. Background rather than day-to-day guidance.

documents.title: Financial Awareness Messages (FAME), 4th Edition
documents.notes: No textual headings -- each page is one self-contained message, so chunk on pages. RBI's font maps the rupee sign onto a backtick: 48 amounts read as `10,000 until repaired. Front matter carries Hindi in a legacy non-Unicode font that extracts as gibberish; it is cover text only.

documents.title: Computation of Tax for Individual
documents.notes: Saved from the browser as HTML: the site blocks scripted fetching, and its PDF is a truncated screenshot of this same page. Refresh by hand after each Finance Act.

documents.title: Deductions allowable to tax payer
documents.notes: Only 56% of the 140 deduction rows apply to individuals; the rest are companies, co-operatives and financial corporations. Audience is therefore classified per chunk, so a question about personal deductions cannot retrieve cattle insurance for milk co-operatives. Carries both old- and new-regime figures for the same relief, so answers must state which regime they mean.
